channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Writers, Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Writers, Asia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: culture360 / ASEF: Call for Content, Arts in the Wake of AI
item.description: Asia-Europe Foundation (ASEF), culture360.ASEF.org · deadline Closed 29 Sep 2026 · SGD 250 fee per commissioned article, podcast or video interview. Up to two proposals per application, of which at most one is selected. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Writers grant - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Earth Journalism Network: Story Grants for Inclusive Water Governance in the Mekong Region 2026
    https://earthjournalism.net/opportunities/story-grants-to-support-reporting-on-inclusive-water-governance-in-the-mekong-region
    Earth Journalism Network (Internews), with support from Oxfam · deadline Closed 14 Jun 2026 · Up to USD 2,000 per story grant; up to 13 grants awarded. Grants issued July 2026. Selected journalists also receive one-on-one mentorship, including from a Gender Equity and Social Inclusion (GESI) specialist. No application fee.
